runs.text: The Tell Tale Tummy /  A Little Help

accessibilityData.label: The Tell Tale Tummy /  A Little Help 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: The Tell-Tale Tummy: Share breaks Grumpy’s Cloud Express invention and tries to hide that she did it. Feeling the guilt, Shares learns about her conscience as it tries to tell her something through her tummy. A Little Help:  Grumpy has too much to handle in preparation for the Rainbow Night celebration, but he won’t ask for help. When Grizzle needs help of his own, Grumpy’s is the first to offer the villain a hand—and THAT makes him take a look at his own situation

Growing Pains: Cheer and Share are battling a brand new monster- the green-eyed monster called jealousy! The giant Grow-Glitter mess they make of their gardens is a BIG problem! King Grumpy: When Grumpy hurts his foot in a Bubble-phonium accident, he takes a little bit too much advantage of Wingnut’s friendly willingness to help out.

Ice Creamed : Grumpy rebuilds Amigo Bear’s ice cream cart so it provides an endless supply of ice cream. What could go wrong with a never-ending quantity of sweet goodness? Heatwave: Grizzle is at it again, using a giant “Magnifrier” to heat up Care-a-lot! Will Share get over her fear of the Thunderwhales and get them to save Care-a-lot with some cooling rain?

Erased: Grizzle’s eraser ray doesn’t quite work, but it did turn the Care Bears’ badges upside down and changed the way they act! Not quite themselves, they learn about being supportive, considerate, and honest, but not before over-doing it in some funny ways!  Unbearable: The Care Bears give Funshine a trophy to say “thank you” for his helpfulness, but it ends up going to his head and getting he and his friends trapped in Grizzle’s lair!

runs.text: Care-ful Bear  / Case of the Grumpies

accessibilityData.label: Care-ful Bear  / Case of the Grumpies 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Care-ful Bear: Funshine feels responsible for Share getting hurt during a game, so he dons a cape to become Care-ful Bear, the champion of safety. Can the Care Bears get Funshine to take off the cape and just play with them again?  A Case of the Grumpies: Grumpy is storming around Care-a-lot and seems grumpier than usual, so Cheer decides to “un-grump the “Grumpster”. But should she be assuming he’d like her surprises, or should she be finding out what’s really bothering him?

accessibilityData.label: Cheer, There and Everywhere / Twinklet 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Cheer, There and Everywhere : Cheer gets to make the special Starshine star for the Starshine Parade, but she lets her friends down by getting caught up in directing and helping everyone else and forgetting something very important that she is supposed to do.  Twinklet:  When a Twinklet, a baby star, gets lost in Care-a-lot, Oopsy decides to adopt her. She leaves a small path of happy, glittery destruction in her path, and makes Oopsy wonder if he’s doing what’s best for the Twinklet.

Belly Ball :  Share thinks that winning a ribbon in a Belly Ball Game will make her friends like her more, so she practices so much that she neglects the very friends she’s actually trying to impress. The Bubbles: Funshine is sick with “The Bubbles” an illness that makes Care Bears start to float away. But he won’t take care of himself, so now he’s hiccupping bubbles and has to stay in bed. Resting is no fun- what could a little extra play hurt?

accessibilityData.label: Rainshine Meadows / Oopsy the Hero 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Rainshine Meadows: Funshine wants to clean up Rainshine Meadows, which is an environmental disaster, and help its inhabitants. Will the actions of one bear make a difference?  Oopsy, the Hero: Oopsy saves Harmony and Cheer from a falling object- by accident! When Care-a-lot dubs him a hero, he doesn’t want to tell them it was all a fluke, but real heroes have to face the truth.

All You Need Is: Oopsy wants his friends to like him, not just accept him, so he puts on some love perfume to win them over- but it’s not the magic aroma that draws them to him in the end!  Gobblebugs: The Gobblebugs are on their way to destroy Care-a-lot but Cheer would rather be testing her brand new Jump Points invention than standing guard against the bugs- a choice that forces her to learn about what is important and about keeping your word.

runs.text: Grizzle-ized/ Share and Share a Like

accessibilityData.label: Grizzle-ized/ Share and Share a Like 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Grizzle-ized :Oopsy is feeling un-special and gets tricked by Grizzle to help him deliver a “gift” for the Care Bears. But is Grizzle’s plan Oopsy-proof?  Share and Share Alike: Share’s been waiting a whole year to make her famous rootbear floats (they make bears float!), but Harmony invites some extra bears without asking first, leaving Share without any rootbear for herself!

runs.text: Dare Bears/ Battle of the Band

accessibilityData.label: Dare Bears/ Battle of the Band 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Dare Bears : Funshine and Tenderheart are in a daring mood, each one trying to one-up the other with a bigger dare. Things get out of hand in Grumpy’s garage, showing that the bears should stick to caring rather than daring.  Battle of the Band: Share, Harmony, Love-a-lot, Cheer and True Heart have formed a band: the Care Bear Honeys, because they are sweet and stick together! Will gossip and jealousy be the thing that un-sticks them

Re-Booted :Grizzle has gotten kicked out of his own lair by his new robot! Stuck in Care-a-lot, the bears welcome him with open arms- will he still try to destroy them even after he learns to care?  Flower Power: Share’s garden is blooming beautifully with Dilly Daisies, made especially beautiful by Bumpity and Tweazle’s special rain. They become a Care-a-lot fashion fad and all the bears learn that it isn’t what you wear, but who you are that counts!

runs.text: Two of a Kind / Stand Up and Cheer

accessibilityData.label: Two of a Kind / Stand Up and Cheer 21 minutes

upcomingEventText.simpleText: Two of a Kind :  The Care Bears are trying to help Grumpy, but he’s getting very flustered and super bossy because they aren’t doing things the “Grumpy way”. Soon, using his own cloning machine Grumpy finds out what it’s like to deal with himself!  Stand Up and Cheer: Care-a-lot is having a Talent Contest! As the bears prepare, Cheer has gotten so distracted helping everyone else that she’s not had time to find a talent of her own, or has she?

title.simpleText: The Tell Tale Tummy /  A Little Help

description.simpleText: Pack your bags for Care-a-Lot and enjoy heartwarming animated tales.Join all of your favorite Care Bears--including accident-prone Oopsy, pessimistic Grumpy, lively Funshine and the ever-optimistic Cheer Bear.As always,the delightful animated fun includes adventures,a few surprises and some unexpected challenges along the way while teaching youngsters positive life lessons.
